carbon_accounting: physical-routing-1: actual atmospheric emissions; internal captured-carbon transfers; terminal geological storage without negative storage emissions

foreground.fuel_trajectory_decision: Approved 2026-09-08: published SI.2 fuel masses at all four anchors replace the internal endpoint-only trajectory in all systems, diagrams and result stages.
foreground.capture_efficiency_policy: fixed and identical for fossil and non-fossil CO2
foreground.storage_label: existing depleted North Sea gas field
foreground.storage_loss_policy: 5% of captured CO2 entering liquefaction, then 1.44% of the remainder during transport; zero additional injection loss and post-injection leakage
foreground.mtx_utility_proxy: data/assumptions/mtx_utility_proxy.json; engineering proxy, not UOP process data; natural gas boiler supplies 0.9672 MJ useful heat/kg methanol, without internal recovery; cooling and equipment remain under review
foreground.methanol_process: Approved 2026-09-06: JRC99380 heat-integrated standalone synthesis, pure-methanol approximation; data/assumptions/standalone_methanol_candidate.json
foreground.synthetic_fuel_design: UOP US20260098223A1 Table 2 adapted to 85% methanol-carbon-to-jet yield
foreground.coproduct_policy: diesel and naphtha fuel use at production year +1; equal-mass composition-equivalent avoided fossil production and combustion credited in production year, without allocation
foreground.residual_carbon_policy: User-approved aggregate closure: methanol-synthesis and methanol-to-X residual carbon becomes non-fossil CO2 in the production year, with no heat credit. This is a webinar assumption, not a UOP-reported fate.
foreground.jet_fuel_credit: avoided upstream fossil jet-fuel production and avoided conventional combustion CO2 are credited in the synthetic-fuel production year
foreground.synthetic_fuel_combustion: non-fossil CO2 from synthetic jet-fuel combustion is released one year after production

heat.modelling_basis: original-study integrated grey-kiln/capture utility and heat-export inventory; user decision 2026-09-06
heat.reconstruction_policy: Do not require or substitute a new temperature-resolved heat network for the original integrated module. Verify source coefficients, units, annual scaling and carbon interfaces. Do not subtract internal recovery a second time.
heat.system_boundary: grey kiln and its integrated capture/CCUS processes; no white-kiln heat capacity imported
heat.heat_recovery_integration: retained in the central case; user reaffirmed 2026-09-06
heat.recovery_boundary_decision: Retain heat recovery as represented in the original integrated study. Do not add white-kiln heat capacity or infer additional heat for the adapted MTX process from integrated district-heat exports.
heat.allocation_decision: User approved capture-first allocation on 2026-09-06. Finite kiln heat may include high-temperature recovery; external suppliers cover remaining duties. Grade-resolved availability remains to be established.
heat.mtx_deficit_supplier: separate natural gas industrial boiler in all model years; useful heat demand, no internal heat recovery or export credit; background combustion uncaptured, no cement-capture integration assumed

production.normalized_temporal_basis: one tonne distributed across campaign production

sensitivity.supplier_time_policy: fixed technology class with annually evolving upstream inventory
